QuestionStmt.S: In LCR series circuit, $R = 18\Omega$ and impedance $33\Omega$. An r.m.s. voltage of 220 V is applied across the circuit. The true power consumed in a.c. circuit is

Solution.S:
Given: $R = 18\Omega$, $Z = 33\Omega$, $V_{\text{rms}} = 220$ V.

$$I_{\text{rms}} = \frac{V_{\text{rms}}}{Z} = \frac{220}{33} = \frac{20}{3} \text{ A}$$

$$P = I_{\text{rms}}^2 R = \left(\frac{20}{3}\right)^2 \times 18 = \frac{400}{9} \times 18 = 800 \text{ W}$$

Thus the correct option is C: 800 W.
